notes.title: Beasties - Release date
notes.notes:
Hello Beasties fans!

This is the Flo from rokaplay with the most awesome news ever! 
Beasties will be released [b]July 1st 2022[/b] on [b]Steam AND Nintendo Switch[/b]!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33025590/84fd96230a4c2c77b56a1036be1f9e57578baffa.jpg[/img]

Isn't that awesome? We have a small request for you, we have [b]7k Wishlists[/b] on Steam and would love to make it into the "popular upcoming" section, for that we are still missing about [b]500[/b] Wishlists. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592600/Beasties__Monster_Trainer_Puzzle_RPG/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33025590/4aa9a90f200e1e36962409092239f91b988590cf.png[/img][/url]
Your support is needed, let's make the release something special together! 
Feel free to share this news with [b]your friends[/b] on social media!

See you soon my friends!

notes.title: Update and Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey future Beastie friends!

Small reminder that you can play the beta version on [b][url=https://rokaplay-hq.itch.io/beasties]itch.io[/url][/b]! 
Meanwhile we made an update and some bug fixes!

[url=https://rokaplay-hq.itch.io/beasties][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274329/34c05a1daadb6df2dc09e9c916e8959d4dbfd667.jpg[/img][/url]

- Removed unfitting environment asset 
- Bridge built during the quest "Hard realities" can be crossed now
- Adjusted Would's level when fighting it during the quest "Wounded pride"
- Heal sfx and vfx plays when Elma feeds your Beasties
- Rebalancing of some combats against wild Beasties
- Added particles to area 3
- Started work on skills for 3 new Beasties, however, these are still WIP
